title: The first oscillation maximum
caption: For maximal mixing (sin²2θ = 1) and Δm² = 2.5 × 10⁻³ eV², P = sin²(1.27Δm²L/E) first reaches 1 where 1.27Δm²L/E = π/2, at L/E ≈ 495 km GeV⁻¹. T2K's 295 km at 0.6 GeV is 492 km GeV⁻¹, close to the first maximum.
alt: A sine-squared curve against L over E in km per GeV, rising from zero to its first peak of 1 near 495 and falling again, with T2K marked near 492.
description: P = sin²2θ × sin²(1.27 Δm² L/E), with Δm² = 2.5 × 10⁻³ eV², L in km, E in GeV.
Maximum when 1.27 × 2.5 × 10⁻³ × L/E = π/2: L/E = 495 km GeV⁻¹.

checks.name: first maximum at L/E ≈ 495 km GeV⁻¹
